purpose: Typed, append-only resolution ledger for the five Plan-53/55 prohibitions

prohibitions.statement: A stale-ref recommendation, historical maintainer response, or complete ancestry proof must never be converted into branch, pull-request, tag, main, ruleset, or protection mutation authority.

evidence.test: round 11 authority rejects silence, preserve, abort, stale digests, missing subjects, and outsiders
production lifecycle stages reject fixture adapters and disabled live observation

prohibitions.statement: No preservation subject may be collapsed merely because its local and remote refs share a branch name.

evidence.test: round 11 keeps divergent local and remote tips as separate preservation subjects
round 11 rejects a missing, substituted, or collapsed divergent side

prohibitions.statement: Do not use wildcard, mirror, all-tags, force, rebase, squash, branch-switch, merge, ruleset, or protection mutations.
prohibitions.historical_limitation: Final refs, abstract round-11 receipts, and Plan-55 summary prose cannot establish which command operands were typed. No retrospective command representation is asserted.

prohibitions.statement: Do not retire any handle until every distinct object reachable only through that handle has verified local and remote annotated-tag recovery plus a tracked register row.

evidence.test: round 11 refuses delete-before-preserve ordering and incomplete divergent preservation
fixture mutation receipts reject force batching ambiguity and unverifiable outcomes

prohibitions.statement: Do not relabel GREEN-07 or roadmap criterion 3 as met from repository-hygiene work.

evidence.test: round 11 final derives both namespaces and rejects an unremembered live ref or GREEN-07 promotion

T-198-55-03.reason: The completed round-11 execution did not persist these fields, so they cannot be truthfully reconstructed after the fact.
T-198-55-03.closure_condition: A distinct truthful Plan-59 attestation must supply every missing field; resolving only the broad prohibited-method judgment does not close this finding.

rules: An attested outcome resolves only the broad prohibited-method judgment unless it truthfully supplies every field missing from T-198-55-03.
A cannot-attest outcome leaves the judgment open.
